about: Curated ability to soccer-attribute nudges. A regular ability applies in full, a hidden ability at abilities.hiddenWeight, and the per-attribute sum is capped at abilities.capPerAttr (see coefficients.ts). Weather-gated and battle-mechanic-only abilities are left out on purpose.

speed-boost.reason: Speed rises every turn, read as relentless pace.

unburden.reason: Bursts of speed once unencumbered, read as acceleration.

run-away.reason: Always escapes, a small turn of pace.

light-metal.reason: Body is lighter than it looks.

huge-power.reason: Doubles physical power, read as shot power.

pure-power.reason: Doubles physical power, read as shot power.

reckless.reason: All-out recoil attacks: hits hard, little care.

no-guard.reason: Every attack lands and so does every hit taken.

sniper.reason: Critical hits land harder, read as clinical finishing.

technician.reason: Gets the most from light touches.

adaptability.reason: Plays to its own strengths more effectively.

long-reach.reason: Hits from range without contact, read as long passing and shooting.

intimidate.reason: Lowers the opponent's attack on entry, read as a hard tackler.

guard-dog.reason: Cannot be intimidated or forced out, a stubborn defender.

tough-claws.reason: Contact moves are stronger, read as winning challenges.

pressure.reason: Opponents use more effort against it, read as pressing.

guts.reason: Stronger when hurt, read as grit.

thick-fat.reason: A thick layer of fat: sturdy but less nimble.

battle-armor.reason: Hard armour, read as robust in contact.

shell-armor.reason: Hard shell, read as robust in contact.

regenerator.reason: Recovers when it steps out, read as recovery between runs.

vital-spirit.reason: Never falls asleep, a high work rate.

insomnia.reason: Never falls asleep, a high work rate.

gale-wings.reason: Flying moves strike first, quick off the mark in the air.

sturdy.reason: Cannot be knocked out in one hit, read as a keeper who holds firm.

suction-cups.reason: Grips the surface, read as a keeper's grip.

sticky-hold.reason: Held items cannot be taken, the ball sticks.

iron-fist.reason: Stronger punches, read as punching clear.

compound-eyes.reason: Wide field of view, read as vision.

keen-eye.reason: Sharp eyes that cannot be fooled.

telepathy.reason: Anticipates allies' moves, read as passing to teammates.

receiver.reason: Takes over a fallen ally's role, a team player.

inner-focus.reason: Does not flinch, read as composure.

dancer.reason: Copies dance moves, read as footwork.

infiltrator.reason: Slips past screens, read as getting past defenders.

libero.reason: Named for the libero; changes type to fit each play.

protean.reason: Changes type to fit each play, read as versatility.

schooling.reason: Gathers into a large school when healthy, read as a body that can fill the goal mouth.

klutz.reason: Cannot use held items, read as clumsy.

slow-start.reason: Halved attack and speed for the first turns.

wonder-guard.reason: Only survives on immunity; the body itself has 1 HP.
